turns.question: What should I cook tonight in Pretoria for two? I have about an hour and I shop at PnP. Give me the recipe and what it'll cost.
turns.answer:
Ek gee dit gou vir my kok; hy's nou-nou terug met 'n antwoord.My kok is terug, hier is wat hy gekry het:

**The dish**
Quick chicken curry with potatoes, onion and baby carrots, all cooked in one pot in about 35 minutes. It suits an hour tonight, serves two, and uses cheap everyday ingredients.

**Recipe**

![Maklike Kerrie Hoender Resep](https://idata.hiloved.com/imgs/71c8af47bc3e39b6-1024x681.jpg)

Serves 2 · about 35 minutes

1. Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a wok or deep frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chopped onion and stir-fry until soft and translucent.
2. Add 2 tbsp yellow curry paste and stir until fragrant. (If you use curry powder instead, add a little water to form a paste.)
3. Add the chicken pieces (cut into about 4 cm chunks) and stir-fry for about 5 minutes until browned and coated in the paste.
4. Add the potatoes (peeled, cut small) and the halved baby carrots. Stir for a minute.
5. Add 1 cup of chicken stock, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp salt and white pepper to taste.
6. Cover and simmer on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes, until the chicken and potatoes are cooked through.
7. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Serve with rice or bread.

Link: https://af.hiloved.com/maklike-kerrie-hoender-resep/
